about.title: About Diovane Alves
about.paragraph1: With more than 3 years of experience in web development, I have been dedicated to creating robust, scalable applications aligned with real business needs.
about.paragraph2: My journey began with a curiosity to understand how things work behind the screen. Over time, that curiosity evolved into a passion for solving complex problems and turning ideas into efficient digital experiences.
about.paragraph3: I am currently seeking an opportunity as a full-stack developer, where I can apply my knowledge to build high-performance and well-structured web solutions. I have experience with Vue.js, React, Node.js, Java, Tailwind CSS, among other technologies.
about.paragraph4: Beyond development itself, I value best practices, architecture, API integrations, databases, and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, following agile methodologies to consistently deliver results.
about.paragraph5: I am a lifelong learner, always attentive to new trends and continuously seeking growth. I believe in the power of technology to transform businesses and positively impact lives — that is my daily motivation.
